<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have checked the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor for Tuesday at 16:30.

*   David Okafor has "Travel" from 16:30 to 17:00 on Tuesday.

Both Elena and David are busy at the proposed time. Therefore, this time will not work.

I will now inform Alison about this in the shared workspace. I will also re-iterate the list of available slots for Elena and David. It is important to keep this information at the forefront of our communication to avoid confusion and repeated suggestions of times that are already known to be unavailable.I've checked the calendars. Unfortunately, Tuesday at 16:30 doesn't work for either Elena or David.

Here are the times that still work for them:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Let me know if any of these are possibilities.
